title: 1.5 Mirror the Vault
objective: Invert the tree by clicking rooms bottom-up to swap their children, OR press [Auto Mirror] to self-repair!
controls: Click nodes bottom-up (children before parents) to swap children  |  Or click [Auto Mirror [A]]
start_status: Click rooms bottom-up (lowest subtrees before their parents) to swap left/right children, or press [Auto Mirror [A]]!
hints: Bottom-up inversion swaps left and right children at lower subtrees before swapping at their parent room (or use Auto Mirror).
